findings.text: There's no known cure for this disease, accept possibly glutamine
findings.fix: There's no known cure for this disease, except possibly glutamine

findings.what: "incompleted" is not standard English; "incomplete" (or "uncompleted") is the word.

findings.text: Glutamine an amino acid that's the fuel
findings.what: The verb is missing: "Glutamine an amino acid".
findings.fix: Glutamine is an amino acid that's the fuel

findings.text: For H. Pylori specifically: if you get heartburn when your stomach is empty only, that's usually H. Pylori
findings.what: The species name takes a lower-case p, as the heading and the rest of the article write it (H. pylori).
findings.fix: For H. pylori specifically: if you get heartburn when your stomach is empty only, that's usually H. pylori

findings.text: especially with regard vitamins C, E
findings.fix: especially with regard to vitamins C, E

findings.what: The site is written EndSickness.org everywhere else in the article.

findings.text: the form of zinc which stays in your intestinal gaps
findings.what: Zinc does not "stay in" gaps; what is meant is that this form stays on (sticks to) the intestinal lining, or seals the gaps.
findings.fix: the form of zinc which stays in your intestinal lining

findings.text: or the colonocytes lining your large intestine don't do that, the barrier loosens up
findings.what: "do that" has no action of the cells to point at (the sentence before is about the barrier needing energy), so it reads as a tautology; the sense is that the cells don't get that energy.
findings.fix: or the colonocytes lining your large intestine don't get that energy, the barrier loosens up

findings.what: "advise" (the verb) stands where the noun "advice" is meant.

findings.text: So the phases below are only what the Gem will tell you, from the nine books.
findings.what: Phase 3 puts Joel's own view in its body (avoid most herbal antibiotics, use H2O2 instead, Pooyan's Candibactin story), not under "My notes", so the phases are not only what the Gem says.
findings.fix: So the phases below are what the Gem will tell you, from the nine books, apart from my H2O2 swap in Phase 3.

findings.text: Don't skip any, since you only move on to the next phase if the one you're on doesn't clear up your symptoms.
findings.what: Phase 5 starts once you are clear of infection and Phase 4 only applies if Phase 3 failed, so a reader whose symptoms clear does skip a phase, against "Don't skip any" and the move-on-only-if-not-cleared rule.
findings.fix: Don't skip ahead, since you only move on to the next phase if the one you're on doesn't clear up your symptoms (once you're clear, go to Phase 5).

findings.text: with something that those don't help quickly
findings.what: "help" has the infection as its object, so it says H2O2 and berberine don't help the infection; "clear" (or "help with") is meant.
findings.fix: with something that those don't clear quickly

findings.what: As an instruction to the reader, "bind to the toxins" says the reader attaches to them; the binder binds the toxins.

findings.text: And if the herbs failed, the overgrowth is too severe
findings.what: Two blocks earlier the reader was told to avoid most herbal antibiotics and use H2O2, so "if the herbs failed" assumes a step the reader was told to skip.
findings.fix: And if the antimicrobials failed, the overgrowth is too severe

findings.text: The problem is likely organ failure, or environmental toxicity
findings.what: "Organ failure" names a life-threatening shutdown; the examples that follow (pancreatic insufficiency, bile acid diarrhea) are an organ not working well.
findings.fix: The problem is likely organ dysfunction, or environmental toxicity

findings.text: or brain plasticity (those two are Phase 6, below)
findings.what: Plasticity is the brain's ability to change, the thing DNRS uses, not the problem; Phase 6 names the problem as limbic system impairment.
findings.fix: or brain wiring (those two are Phase 6, below)

findings.fix: It's quite common for the prebiotic
